description: Choose where on Snapchat an ad squad's ads may appear: automatic (everywhere) or custom positions (PUBLIC_STORIES_INSTREAM, INTERSTITIAL_CONTENT, INTERSTITIAL_SPOTLIGHT, INTERSTITIAL_USER, FEED, CAMERA, CHAT_FEED; CHAT_FEED must come with INTERSTITIAL_CONTENT or INTERSTITIAL_USER). Fewer placements usually mean less reach and a higher cost. Refused on ad squads that use content inclusion or exclusion lists. Undo works when a placement was set before. Previews unless confirm=true. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token.

adsquad_id.description: Ad squad id. Get it from snap_list_adsquads.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

mode.description: How to apply the value (see the tool description for the choices).

positions.description: Where ads may appear when mode is custom (see the tool description for the names).

name: snap_set_placement
